destructive_actions: cleaning and plugin mutation are separate xEdit modes and are not enabled by this adapter invocation
human_checks: xEdit definition false positives or version-specific definition defects require corroboration before changing plugin semantics

coverage.description: Read-only xEdit structural oracle using the built-in CheckForErrors tool mode, with the resulting session parsed by parse_xedit_check_errors.py.
known_gaps: xEdit definitions can contain version-specific false positives
a structurally clean plugin can still be semantically or runtime incorrect
the Windows/MO2 host must expose the same VFS/load-order environment used by the tested project
coverage.denominator_probe: completion summary Processed Records and Errors found counts plus parser finding/count reconciliation

safety.sandbox_or_scope: Run against a disposable MO2/test profile when VFS resolution matters; CheckForErrors itself does not save plugin mutations.

verification.version_probe: Pin xEdit release and executable SHA-256 in the toolchain lock.
verification.output_readback: Require a fresh -R log containing a completed Check for Errors session, then parse it into skyrim-xedit-error-report-v1.

ai.context_cost_notes: Feed the normalized JSON report to gates/analyzers instead of entire xEdit logs unless raw evidence is needed.

evidence.notes: Current upstream source exposes checkforerrors as a tool mode; xEdit docs/source document game-mode switches, quickedit/autoload selection and -R log-path handling. Parser remains fail-closed on incomplete sessions.
